label: AXOS E9-2 Intelligent Access Appliance
description: Calix AXOS E9-2 modular access appliance/OLT that scales to 16 PON line cards in one managed system. This spec models one GP1612 line card in slot 1: 16 SFP GPON ports (gpon1/1-16) + its 2x QSFP-28 40/100G uplinks = 18 ports. The CLX3001 control card separately adds 2x QSFP-28, 8x SFP+ and 2x SFP for aggregation.
